entities.name: UAC-0056
entities.gloss: A cyber espionage threat actor targeting Ukrainian state and defense organizations.

entities.name: Cobalt Strike Beacon
entities.gloss: A post-exploitation payload and agent component of the Cobalt Strike adversary simulation framework.

entities.name: write.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious dropper executable dropped by a macro in an Excel document.

entities.name: TRYxaEbX
entities.gloss: An encrypted payload file created on disk by a dropper executable.

entities.gloss: A malicious PowerShell script used in an attack sequence.

entities.name: TRYxaEbX_2.ps1
entities.gloss: A malicious PowerShell script designed to decode and execute Cobalt Strike Beacon.
